dict.string: Satchel uses the microphone when you record audio or narration. Recordings stay on this Mac.
Satchel turns speech into text on this Mac. Audio is not uploaded.
Satchel uses the camera only if you take a photo to scan a page. Photos are not uploaded.
Satchel reads and writes files you choose on the Desktop. Original files are left unchanged.
Satchel reads and writes files you choose in Documents. Original files are left unchanged.
Satchel reads and writes files you choose in Downloads, including when you organize that folder.
Satchel ejects removable disks only after you confirm.
Satchel captures the screen only while you use Screenshot or Record Screen.
Satchel reads the current Wi-Fi name so it can look up that network’s saved password. Your location is not stored or sent.
Satchel reads the current Wi-Fi network name so it can look up that network’s saved password. Your location is not stored or sent.
Satchel uses Automation only when a tool needs to coordinate with Finder or another app on this Mac.
Satchel accesses Contacts only when a tool needs contact details you choose. Nothing leaves this Mac.
Satchel accesses Photos only when you choose pictures from your library. Photos stay on this Mac.
